assertions.subject: release-manifest.json binds the three component identities
assertions.note: Read back from the produced artifact, not restated from the ticket.

assertions.subject: section 3 of the manual verifies every SHA256SUMS entry
assertions.expected: no mismatch across all listed files
assertions.control: the same hash comparison over a one-byte-flipped copy of RELEASE-CANDIDATE.md reported a mismatch: True (must be True)

assertions.subject: onboard appsettings.json built from the production template
assertions.expected: no REPLACE_ placeholder survives, build commit equals the packaged onboard commit
assertions.note: Ticket 13 ran the shipped development file instead; that is the configuration gap ticket 26 traced.

assertions.subject: environment=Production rejects a loopback ControlServer host
assertions.expected: the run binds a non-loopback address, because the onboard guard refuses loopback in Production
assertions.control: the first attempt of this run used localhost and the onboard refused to start with 软件无法启动，请联系维护人员检查程序配置 and produced no log directory at all
assertions.note: Configuration.cs IsForbiddenProductionHost covers both wireToGate.host and vehicleSafety.endpoint. This is a deployment guard working, not a defect; it does mean a same-machine acceptance must use a non-loopback local interface.

assertions.subject: the deployment starts from an empty database and an empty onboard journal
eight-slot IO simulator Modbus 1502 and control plane 58006
assertions.note: SIMULATED IO. Not evidence about real IO modules, wiring, locks or light curtains.

assertions.subject: ControlServer.Host.exe starts straight from the RC package tree
assertions.expected: TLS transport on 58405 and HTTPS health on 58407

assertions.subject: the HTTPS vehicle-safety projection is credential gated
assertions.control: the same pinned request without an Authorization header returned HTTP_STATUS=401 (must not be 200)
assertions.note: Pinned to the certificate generated by this run; any other root fails the transport.

assertions.subject: the real RIoT reports the configured vehicle stopped, with fresh evidence
assertions.expected: motionState STOPPED, no reason codes, observedAt within 30s
assertions.control: the same detector against the same endpoint returned UNKNOWN / RIOT_READ_TIMEOUT while the workstation path to RIoT was hijacked; see riot-path-red.json
assertions.note: This is the fact ticket 26 identified as missing; here it is read live rather than replayed.

assertions.subject: GET /health/ready before any onboard session
assertions.note: Documented expected result; it is also the control for HEALTH-READY.

assertions.subject: the packaged OnboardHmi binary establishes a TLS session with the packaged ControlServer
assertions.expected: onboard log records 上层会话已建立
assertions.actual: 2026-08-30T18:23:28.2363022+08:00	Information	WireToGateSessionService	上层会话已建立：generation=1，readiness=Ready。
assertions.control: the same detector over the same directory before the onboard started returned '<none>' (must be none)
assertions.note: useTls=true with a pinned SHA-256, so this also exercises the transport pin and the Windows chain.

assertions.subject: onboard readiness on a clean install once the documented prerequisites are met
assertions.control: the same detector on the same RC lineage returned RecoveryRequired for ticket 13, whose run left vehicleSafety disabled
assertions.note: Ticket 26 predicted this transition from a replayed handshake; this run produces it live.

assertions.subject: GET /health/ready once the onboard session reports Ready
assertions.control: HEALTH-GATED-BEFORE recorded 503 on the same endpoint minutes earlier, so a 200 here is the session and not a permissive gate

assertions.subject: the MesIngest adapter reads real demands from the existing MesIngest
assertions.control: StationOperations=0 on the same database, so this is a specific read and not every table being filled

assertions.subject: the RIoT read path leaves a durable row derived from a real RIoT read
assertions.expected: StationTaskTypeAdmissions populated from the RIoT map station catalog
assertions.control: RiotDispatchAuditEvents=0 in the same run, so a populated admission table is the read path and not the create path
assertions.note: Ticket 13 had to leave this INCONCLUSIVE because the runtime never reached the read.

assertions.subject: a WIRE_TO_GATE demand is accepted from the real backlog
assertions.control: ticket 13 held the same tables at 0 with 282 demands in the backlog, because readiness never reached Ready

assertions.subject: no RIoT order was created during acceptance
assertions.control: the same table is what a real create writes; the authorized field runs show it non-empty

assertions.subject: the deployment restarts on the same data root
the onboard reconnects after the server restart and readiness returns
assertions.expected: session generation advances and readiness is Ready again
assertions.control: a generation that did not advance would mean the reconnect was never observed; the pre-restart value is recorded above

assertions.subject: GET /health/ready after the restart
assertions.control: the same endpoint returned 503 before any session existed in this very run

assertions.subject: stored state survives the restart on both sides
assertions.expected: server inbox does not shrink and the onboard journal is not recreated
assertions.control: CLEAN-STATE recorded both stores absent at the start of the run, so these are grown rather than assumed

assertions.subject: Install-ControlServerLocal.ps1 service installation, ACL hardening and lifecycle
assertions.actual: not exercised: this session has no administrator token
assertions.note: The manual section 4 path needs elevation. This run starts the packaged host directly, which qualifies the binaries but not the installer.

assertions.subject: the NDJSON file log described in manual section 7
assertions.actual: not exercised: the file sink is configured by appsettings.Production.json, which only the installer writes
assertions.note: Follows from INSTALL-AS-SERVICE. This run captured stdout instead; the manual itself warns that a hand deployment has no persistent log.

assertions.subject: pickup, multi-slot load, movement, gate batch unload and atomic completion
assertions.expected: one full WIRE_TO_GATE journey on the real vehicle
assertions.actual: not attempted: the RIoT create gate stayed closed and no per-run safety GO was given
assertions.note: SAFETY-NO-CREATE is the positive evidence that this run did not move the vehicle.

assertions.subject: screen, touch and barcode scanner on the target vehicle terminal
real eight-slot IO module, wiring, locks and light curtains
every port this run opened is released
the temporary loopback root is removed from CurrentUser/Root
